newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX gets late dollar boost, ends up 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: German DAX gets late dollar boost, ends up 0.8 pct.

text.p: 1137 GMT - German DAX extends gains to end bourse session up 0.8 percent. Market tracking Bunds, dollar's approach toward 1.89 marks but buying interest selective, mood still uncertain.
Outlook for afternoon is mild positive tone, but market still seen vulnerable to renewed rate rise fears.
* DAX index ends bourse up 32.71 points at 4,335.39 points.
* September DTB DAX future up three points at 4,356.0.
* Selective buy interest in BASF AG, Siemens AG, technical factors cited.
* German jobless data had little initial impact, but seen supporting case against imminent rate rise.
